title: An integer overflow condition in the AMD Compressonator SDK could allow an attacker with local access to supply a…
description: An integer overflow vulnerability in the AMD Compressonator SDK allows a local attacker to supply a specially crafted DirectDraw Surface (DDS) file, potentially causing a denial of service (DoS). This flaw requires local access and user interaction to exploit. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.1.
